rule: Nothing stays open more than six episodes. Every row below records the episode it was raised in, what the listener was waiting for, the episode it had to pay by, and the episode it actually paid in.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Why the district register says chaitra's father is dead when he dropped her at the bus stand that morning
promises.how_paid: mallesha states the whole mechanism in eleven sentences in the cowshed and does not defend himself once.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Whether chaitra ever gets the appointment she topped the taluk for
promises.how_paid: basavaraj reads serial nine of the appointment list aloud in the same corridor to the same ninety witnesses.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Whose face is in the photograph gummed to the 1994 appointment order
promises.how_paid: ratnamma's wedding photograph identifies the appointee as mallesha's elder brother; mallesha confirms it in ep6.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: What happens about the engagement tray returned at the gate for the lane to see
promises.how_paid: harsha's family bring the tray back; chaitra refuses the match aloud in the corridor, in the same public form in which it was withdrawn.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: What the twelve hundred rupees a month has been buying for twenty-four years
promises.how_paid: thammanna states his terms to chaitra's face at the block office: it was silence, and the price has just gone up to four acres and a resignation.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: What happens to the four acres by the canal
promises.how_paid: sale deed 1147 and the mutation referred for cancellation, the identification being of a deceased person; the pre-2011 entry restored and made by kempanna as the last entry of his career.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Whether anyone at that school will ever say mallesha's real name out loud
promises.how_paid: chaitra says it from the back of the enquiry hall and girija repeats it in front of the full staff, nineteen years after she started teaching in the next room.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Whether ratnamma ever gets her eleven-day marriage recognised
promises.how_paid: proof of marriage accepted under rule sixty-one on the temple seva register plus two attesting statements; family pension sanctioned by order 947/22, which ratnamma reads aloud by its number.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Whether chaitra's own birth entry can be corrected
promises.how_paid: corrected in column four by order of the tahsildar on the second of month three; confirmed aloud by revanna before the list is read. Ran two episodes past its target because the correction file was in thammanna's almirah until his arrest — flagged as the one slippage in the ledger.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: What happens on the fifth, the deadline thammanna set
promises.how_paid: the fifth passes, the audit team sits, and thammanna hands over nothing — establishing that he was never selling silence, he was buying the right to choose the month.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: What inchara does with the family tree photocopy she has held since 2019
promises.how_paid: she trades it for the office file copy of the 2019 complaint and hands chaitra the covering slip with thammanna's signature on it; her byline lands above the fold in ep14.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Who wrote the anonymous 2019 complaint that revanna received and puttaraju buried
promises.how_paid: thammanna claims authorship in his recorded statement and the office file copy proves it — he wrote the complaint, wrote the nil report that buried it, and waited three years for the month chaitra's verification came up.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: What thammanna does with the service file he requisitioned at 09:20
promises.how_paid: he produces it and the receipt counterfoils as the evidentiary spine of his own statement, converting twenty-four years of extortion into twenty-four years of evidence against the family.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: What shankarappa's registered letter to revanna sets off
promises.how_paid: the departmental enquiry convenes at the school under nagaraj; shankarappa admits article two orally in front of his own staff.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Whether shankarappa's eleven years of silence and his pending building sanction are ever settled
promises.how_paid: permanent censure entered in his service book with nothing removed at retirement, and the second building block signed the same morning — the punishment his, the classrooms the children's.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Whether savithri is dragged through a four-year court case
promises.how_paid: ratnamma withdraws the claim as against respondent two and says so in front of the lane; savithri says it back out loud, on ratnamma's insistence.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Why thammanna paid for lokanath's funeral rites three weeks before he was ever deputed to the village
promises.how_paid: read aloud in the corridor as the first of chaitra's three documents; taken with the 2011 identification it establishes he built the arrangement rather than stumbled into it, and it is the ground on which nagaraj hands the matter to the police.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Whether mallesha is prosecuted and what the recovery comes to
promises.how_paid: dismissed from service, criminal reference made the same day, recovery upheld but reduced by the three lakh forty-five thousand six hundred rupees proved extorted. He is not rescued. He is named — which was the promise, and the only one the story ever made about him.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Whether puttaraju answers for signing sixty-one files without reading one of them
promises.how_paid: suspended pending enquiry in the corridor, and told to explain the sixty-one files to somebody senior to revanna.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Whether the 2011 power of attorney savithri signed for eleven thousand rupees destroys the family
promises.how_paid: it destroys thammanna instead: he signed it as identifying witness, certifying savithri as the wife of a man seventeen years dead, in a registered instrument in the state's own strong room.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Whether the recovery notice for one crore eleven lakh forty thousand rupees is enforced against chaitra and her mother as heirs
promises.how_paid: revanna states aloud that the sum recoverable is pressed against thammanna to the extent of the twenty-four years of payments, and that ratnamma's arrears come out of that and not out of the family.

promises.listener_is_waiting_for: Whether prakash is ever told anything by anybody
promises.how_paid: he demands it in the corridor and revanna orders it put in the record — the smallest promise in the season and the only one paid by an official instruction.

audit.notes: p02, p04 and p06 are deliberate season-length promises raised in the first three episodes and cashed in the last, which is the shape the format wants. p09 is the single row that paid two episodes after its target; it is recorded honestly rather than backdated.
